newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony says sells 800,000 PlayStations in December.
newsitem.headline: Sony says sells 800,000 PlayStations in December.

text.p: Sony Computer Entertainment said on Thursday it has shipped about 800,000 PlayStation 32-bit game players in December in the domestic market.
Cumulative shipments of the players since the launch in December 1994, as a result, reached five million units on January 8, a company spokeswoman said.
The figure was achieved about three months earlier than the original plan, she said.
Sony Computer Entertainment is a unit of Sony Corp.
"Strong demand during the Christmas and New Year sales season has temporarily caused a short supply at some areas," the company said in a statement.
Sony plans to further raise production to cope with a global demand increase, the company said.
On the global market, cumulative shipments of PlayStations amounted to 11 million units by early January, she said.
